recommendation: Keep this audit commit and do not reintroduce a separate Provenance.entity Identifier choice. Future wording changes should be handled as new targeted Provenance or Reference issues.
issue_request: FHIR-12748 was a Published/Persuasive Security change request raised and applied for DSTU2 asking to add Identifier to Provenance.entity so source material that is not a FHIR Resource can be identified.
initial_application: Commit 8058a0886c12cc7a61a61db3edae51be5e5698ef explicitly cited GF#12748 and changed the old Provenance.entity.reference model to Provenance.entity.what[x] with uri|Reference(Any)|Identifier choices, updated examples to whatIdentifier, and added an entity-id token search path.
additional_context: FHIR-13694 clarified Reference.identifier logical-reference semantics. FHIR-13570 aligned Provenance with that clarification, FHIR-15659 later removed redundant Provenance Identifier|Reference choices, and FHIR-49893 corrected the current Provenance.entity.what comment to refer to what.identifier. Existing combined-branch audit commits already cover FHIR-13570 and FHIR-15659.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active current build lists Provenance, Provenance.entity.what is a Reference(Any) with a comment directing non-resource entities to what.identifier, and Reference.identifier is an Identifier with logical-reference guidance for concepts without actual FHIR instances.

related_jiras.note: Clarified Reference.identifier semantics for logical references and explains why Provenance can use Reference.identifier for source material without a FHIR instance.
Aligned Provenance entity and agent choices with Reference.identifier guidance; already represented on the combined branch.
Removed redundant Provenance Identifier|Reference choice elements after logical references were introduced; already represented on the combined branch.
Corrected the current Provenance.entity.what comment to refer to what.identifier, confirming the current Reference.identifier model.
